headline: HC upholds death sentence for rape and murder of 8-year-old
summary: The High Court has confirmed the capital punishment for Hitu Sheikh, the lone accused in the rape and murder of a young girl in Magura.
details: The High Court has upheld the death sentence of Hitu Sheikh for the rape and murder of an 8-year-old girl named Asiya in Magura. A bench comprising Justice Bhishmadev Chakraborty and Justice K.M. Rasheduzzaman Raja delivered the verdict on Monday.
caption:
A man faces the gallows after the High Court upheld his death sentence for the rape and murder of an 8-year-old girl.

The High Court has upheld the death sentence of Hitu Sheikh for the rape and murder of an 8-year-old girl named Asiya in Magura. A bench comprising Justice Bhishmadev Chakraborty and Justice K.M. Rasheduzzaman Raja delivered the verdict on Monday.

headline: Gold prices drop by up to 4,474 taka per bhori in Bangladesh
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) announced the price reduction on Monday, following a decline in the international gold market.
details: The price of gold in the local market has decreased by a maximum of 4,474 taka per bhori. The new prices became effective from 10 AM on Monday morning.
caption:
Gold prices in Bangladesh have dropped again, with a maximum decrease of 4,474 taka per bhori.

The price of gold in the local market has decreased by a maximum of 4,474 taka per bhori. The new prices became effective from 10 AM on Monday morning.
